steps: Click the Start button, then click the gear icon to open Settings.
Select "System", then scroll down and click "About".
Under "Windows specifications", read the line labelled "Version" (for example 22H2) and the line "OS build" (for example 19045.4046).
Report the OS build number, including the digits after the dot.
Click the Start button and open Settings (the gear icon).
Click "System" in the left-hand list, then scroll down and click "About".
Under "Windows specifications", read the "Version" line (for example 23H2) and the "OS build" line (for example 22631.3737).
Report the full OS build number, including the digits after the dot.
Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of the screen.
Choose "About This Mac".
Read the version shown next to "macOS" (for example "Sonoma 14.5").
Report the number, such as 14.5.
Open the "Settings" application from the Activities menu or the app grid.
Scroll to the bottom of the left-hand list and click "About" (it may be called "System Details").
Read the line labelled "OS Name" or "OS Version" (for example "Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS").
Report the version number, such as 24.04.
Click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of Chrome.
Choose "Help", then "About Google Chrome".
The version number is shown on that page, for example "128.0.6613.120". Chrome also checks for updates when you open this page.
Report the full number, including the parts after each dot.
Click the menu button (three horizontal lines) in the top-right corner.
Choose "Help", then "About Firefox".
Read the version number shown in the window that opens, for example "128.0.3".
Report that number.
Click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of Edge.
Choose "Help and feedback", then "About Microsoft Edge".
Read the version number on that page, for example "127.0.2651.98".
Report the full number, including the parts after each dot.
Open Safari, then click "Safari" in the menu bar at the top of the screen.
Choose "About Safari".
Read the version number in the small window that appears, for example "Version 17.5".
Report that number. Safari updates come through the macOS Software Update screen.
Open the Zoom app and sign in if asked.
Click your profile picture or initials in the top-right corner.
Choose "About Zoom" (on some versions this is under "Help").
Read the version number shown, for example "6.1.0 (18631)", and report the part before the parenthesis.
Open Discord.
Click the gear icon ("User Settings") next to your name at the bottom-left of the window.
Scroll down the left-hand list; the version is printed in small grey text at the very bottom (for example "Stable 349043").
Report that number.
Open VLC media player.
Click "Help" in the menu bar at the top of the window.
Choose "About".
Read the version number near the top of the window that opens, for example "3.0.21", and report it.
Open the 7-Zip File Manager from the Start menu.
Click the "Help" menu at the top, then choose "About 7-Zip".
Read the version number shown at the top of the window, for example "7-Zip 24.08".
Report the number, such as 24.08.
Open Adobe Acrobat Reader.
Click the "Help" menu at the top of the window (on newer versions, click the menu button with three lines, then "Help").
Choose "About Adobe Acrobat Reader".
Read the version shown, for example "2024.002.20933", and report the full number.
Open Notepad++.
Click the "?" menu at the right-hand end of the menu bar.
Choose "About Notepad++".
Read the version number in the window that opens, for example "8.6.9", and report it.
Open Wireshark.
Click the "Help" menu at the top of the window.
Choose "About Wireshark".
On the "Wireshark" tab, read the version near the top (for example "Version 4.2.6") and report it.
Open the Steam app.
Click the "Steam" menu in the top-left corner.
Choose "About Steam".
Read the line that gives the build date and number (for example "Built: 10 Jul 2024"). Report the build date shown.
Open any Office program, such as Word or Excel.
Click "File", then "Account" (or "Office Account").
Click "About Word" (or the matching program name).
Read the version and build near the top, for example "Version 2406 (Build 17726.20206)", and report the build number.
Open iTunes.
Click the "Help" menu at the top of the window.
Choose "About iTunes".
Read the version number shown (for example "12.13.2.3") and report it.
Open WinRAR from the Start menu.
Click the "Help" menu at the top, then choose "About WinRAR".
Read the version shown in the small window, for example "WinRAR 7.01".
Report the number, such as 7.01.
Open the Windows Control Panel and click the "Java" icon (the coffee cup) to open the Java Control Panel.
On the "General" tab, click the "About..." button.
Read the version line, for example "Version 8 Update 421 (build 1.8.0_421-b09)".
Report the update number, such as "8 Update 421".
Open Thunderbird.
Click the menu button (three horizontal lines) in the top-right corner.
Choose "Help", then "About Thunderbird".
Read the version number in the window that opens, for example "128.0.1", and report it.
Open any LibreOffice program, such as Writer or Calc.
Click the "Help" menu at the top of the window.
Choose "About LibreOffice".
Read the version number shown, for example "24.2.5.2", and report it.
